title: Most Frequent Element
description:
Return the element that appears most frequently in the list. If there is a tie, return the one that appears first in the list.

**Example:**
```
most_frequent([1, 3, 3, 2, 1, 1]) → 1
most_frequent([4, 4, 5, 5, 6]) → 4
most_frequent([7]) → 7
```
hint: Count occurrences of each element. Track the max count, returning the element that first reached it.
